main.title: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius
main.subtitle: A crystal story built for the phone
main.summary: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius was a free-to-play role-playing video game developed by Alim and published by Square Enix for iOS and Android.

cards.heading: A new journey, familiar heroes
cards.text: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius is Alim and Square Enix's free-to-play mobile role-playing game, first released in Japan in October 2015. The knights Rain and Lasswell meet Fina, a girl connected to the world's crystals. Players explore towns and dungeons, find treasure and undertake quests, then tap units to attack or select abilities through touch commands. Characters and summons from earlier Final Fantasy games join this new story, bringing familiar faces into its battles.

cards.heading: After the live service
cards.text: It was shut down outside of Japan on October 30, 2024, and in Japan on October 31, 2025. An enhanced remake titled Final Fantasy Resonance was released for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S and Windows on October 22, 2026, with the Steam edition following on October 23.

main.title: The Legend of Zelda: Tri Force Heroes
main.subtitle: Three heroes, a totem and the art of cooperation
main.summary: The Legend of Zelda: Tri Force Heroes is a 2015 action-adventure game developed by Nintendo EPD and Grezzo and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo 3DS.

cards.heading: Three players, one adventure
cards.text: The Legend of Zelda: Tri Force Heroes is a 2015 action-adventure game developed by Nintendo EPD and Grezzo and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo 3DS. The second original Nintendo 3DS entry in The Legend of Zelda series after A Link Between Worlds, this game is the third installment in the franchise to prominently feature a multiplayer campaign after Four Swords and Four Swords Adventures, albeit this time with only three players as opposed to four and a stronger emphasis on cooperation rather than competition.

cards.heading: A curse out of fashion
cards.text: The story follows the same incarnation of Link from the aforementioned A Link Between Worlds, who this time is called forth along with two other Links by the fashion-obsessed kingdom of Hytopia to lift a curse placed on their princess, Styla, from the evil Drablands Witch.

cards.heading: The Nintendo 3DS release
cards.text: Tri Force Heroes first released in Japan on October 22, 2015, followed by North America and Europe the next day. It received generally mixed reviews from critics. While the game's presentation, soundtrack and multiplayer were praised, many reviewers criticized the game's single-player mode and its online functionality and matchmaking features. The game sold over 1.36 million copies worldwide.

main.title: Halo 5: Guardians
main.subtitle: Two Spartan teams and a new scale of combat
main.summary: Halo 5: Guardians is a 2015 first-person shooter game developed by 343 Industries and published by Microsoft Studios for the Xbox One.

cards.heading: Blue Team against Fireteam Osiris
cards.text: Halo 5: Guardians is a 2015 first-person shooter game developed by 343 Industries and published by Microsoft Studios for the Xbox One. Set in the 26th century, the plot follows two fireteams of human supersoldiers: Blue Team, led by Master Chief, and Fireteam Osiris, led by Spartan Locke. When Blue Team goes absent without leave to track down the artificial intelligence construct Cortana, Master Chief's loyalty is called into question and Fireteam Osiris is sent to retrieve him. Players fight enemies with an armament of different weaponry and vehicles in story-based and multiplayer modes, including a larger-format 24-person mode called Warzone.

cards.heading: Xbox One, Warzone and the 60 fps target
cards.text: 343 Industries started to plan Halo 5 shortly after the release of its predecessor, Halo 4. In late 2012, the team set goals for the game, including larger campaign and multiplayer areas. Different departments worked collaboratively to build off each other's work for the campaign mode. The move to the Xbox One console allowed the development of the Warzone mode alongside traditional multiplayer modes, part of 343 Industries' focus on allowing for different play styles. Its game engine dynamically adjusts its resolution to maintain a frame rate of 60 frames per second; the focus on performance meant that split-screen multiplayer and LAN play were not included.

cards.heading: The announcement and 2015 launch
cards.text: Following an E3 2013 teaser, Microsoft formally revealed Halo 5: Guardians in May 2014. Its first-week launch generated more than $400 million in global game and associated hardware sales. Upon release, Halo 5 received positive reviews from critics, with praise directed at its gameplay, visuals, level design and multiplayer modes. However, the game's single-player campaign met divided responses, with criticism directed at its story, writing, and ending. A sequel, Halo Infinite, was released on December 8, 2021.

main.title: Honor of Kings
main.subtitle: A mobile MOBA from China to a global audience
main.summary: Honor of Kings brings multiplayer online battle-arena play to mobile devices. Developed by TiMi Studio Group and published by Tencent, it is built around opposing teams and their chosen heroes.

cards.heading: A competitive arena on the phone
cards.text: Honor of Kings is a multiplayer online battle arena (MOBA) video game developed by TiMi Studio Group and published by Tencent Games for iOS, HarmonyOS NEXT, and Android.

cards.heading: The Chinese launch and Arena of Valor
cards.text: The Chinese rollout began in October 2015; the Chinese App Store listing dates the iOS release to October 28. An official public beta followed on November 26, 2015. In October 2016, an international adaptation, Arena of Valor, was released, utilizing the same game engine but altering the user interfaces and heroes to accommodate the Western market. As of November 2020, Honor of Kings had over 100 million daily active players, making it one of the most popular games in the world. It is the highest-grossing mobile game of all time and one of the most downloaded apps globally.

cards.heading: The international rollout
cards.text: In June 2022, Level Infinite, the publisher of Arena of Valor, announced that Honor of Kings would be released globally through a separate version by the end of 2022. In May 2024, the worldwide launch of the global version was announced for 20 June 2024, following pre-releases in Brazil and Turkey as well as countries in the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia, and the Commonwealth of Independent States. Honor of Kings was the highest-grossing mobile game in the world in 2024, with $2.6 billion gross.

main.title: Golden Joystick Awards 2015
main.summary: The Golden Joystick Awards, with every category winner of the 2015 edition.

cards.heading: The players' awards
cards.text: The Golden Joystick Awards celebrate games through a public vote, bringing players into the choice of each year's winners. The awards began in Britain with the 1983 season and later reached an international audience through online voting. Their changing categories trace the growth of games: home computers and consoles, handhelds, online play, independent studios, performance and music. Alongside the public vote, special honours recognise individual contributions to the industry. Each edition preserves its own category names, so the results also show what players and the awards organisers considered worth celebrating at the time.

main.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops III
main.subtitle: The Body Becomes a Weapon
main.summary: Call of Duty: Black Ops III is a 2015 first-person shooter game developed by Treyarch and published by Activision.

cards.heading: A War Across Two Generations
cards.text: Call of Duty: Black Ops III is a 2015 first-person shooter game developed by Treyarch and published by Activision. It is the twelfth entry in the Call of Duty series and the sequel to the 2012 video game Call of Duty: Black Ops II. It was released on PlayStation 4, Windows, and Xbox One on November 6, 2015. A feature-limited version developed by Beenox and Mercenary Technology that only supports multiplayer modes was released on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 and was also the final Call of Duty title released on those platforms.

cards.heading: The Augmented Soldier
cards.text: Black Ops III takes place in 2065, in a world affected by climate change and advanced technology. Its black ops soldiers use cybernetic enhancements, and the campaign supports four-player cooperation across larger, more open levels. Alongside that campaign, Zombies supplies a separate cooperative mode. Nightmares also revisits the campaign with undead enemies, changing the opposition encountered through its missions.

cards.heading: A New Partnership, a Major Success
cards.text: Announced in late April 2015, the game is the first Call of Duty video game released after Activision ended its partnership with Microsoft Studios and instead partnered with Sony Computer Entertainment, which secured the timed exclusivity of the game's downloadable content. Upon release, the game received generally positive reviews from critics, praising the gameplay, Zombies mode, and amount of content. However, it was also criticized for its story and lack of innovation. The seventh-generation console versions in particular were singled out for their performance issues and lack of features. It was a commercial success, becoming the top-selling retail game in the US in 2015. A prequel, Call of Duty: Black Ops 4, was released in 2018.

main.title: Fallout 4
main.subtitle: Scavenging and building in the Commonwealth
main.summary: Fallout 4 combines exploration and combat around ruined Boston with crafting, settlement building and a voiced protagonist.

cards.heading: Exploring the Commonwealth
cards.text: Fallout 4 is Bethesda Game Studios? 2015 role-playing game, released on November 10 for PC, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One. Players explore the Commonwealth around ruined Boston in first or third person. Collected objects supply crafting materials, settlements can be built, and V.A.T.S. slows combat to help select attacks.

cards.heading: Boston after the catastrophe
cards.text: Boston?s landmarks, neighbourhoods and elevated roads appear through the series? retrofuturist style. Colonial architecture and atomic technology share the landscape with two centuries of ruin. Terminals, abandoned rooms and objects reveal smaller stories while players explore.

cards.heading: Junk becomes building material
cards.text: Junk breaks down into components such as screws, copper and steel. These feed weapon modifications and settlement construction. Players can build beds, defences, generators and structures, then connect communities with supply lines.

cards.heading: Choosing attacks with V.A.T.S.
cards.text: V.A.T.S. slows time while the player selects body parts and spends Action Points on attacks. Real-time aiming, recoil and weapon handling also received attention. Players can alternate between ordinary shooting and V.A.T.S. during the same encounter.

cards.heading: A fully voiced protagonist
cards.text: Brian T. Delaney and Courtenay Taylor recorded thousands of lines for the two versions of the protagonist. Conversations use alternating camera angles and short reply options. The voiced performance gives the character a defined delivery during exchanges.

cards.heading: Lighting and materials
cards.text: Bethesda updated the renderer with physically based materials, dynamic lighting, volumetric effects and shadows. Metal, plastic, wood and leather respond differently as players move between interiors and daylight. The lighting works with the changing time of day.

cards.heading: The Creation Kit and console mods
cards.text: The Creation Kit lets community authors alter quests, objects, rules, interfaces and spaces. Console mod support later brought this tradition to Xbox One and, with different restrictions, PlayStation 4. The Commonwealth became a setting for player-made additions as well as Bethesda?s own releases.

main.title: Star Wars Battlefront (2015)
main.subtitle: Battles across the original trilogy
main.summary: DICE?s Star Wars Battlefront recreates locations from the original trilogy for multiplayer battles and cooperative missions.

cards.heading: The original trilogy as a battlefield
cards.text: Star Wars Battlefront is DICE?s 2015 multiplayer shooter, published by Electronic Arts. Battles and cooperative missions use locations, vehicles and characters from the original trilogy. Its Frostbite-powered presentation was developed with access to Lucasfilm?s reference materials.

cards.heading: Photogrammetry and Lucasfilm references
cards.text: DICE used photogrammetry to capture rocks, vegetation and other real surfaces as digital assets. Lucasfilm?s references helped the team reconstruct the films? locations, uniforms and equipment. Endor, Hoth and Tatooine combine recognisable designs with detailed materials.

cards.heading: Infantry, vehicles and heroes
cards.text: Walker Assault supports up to forty players around objectives involving infantry, turrets, speeders, AT-STs and AT-ATs. Hero power-ups let players take control of characters such as Luke Skywalker, Darth Vader and Boba Fett within the larger battle. Offline and cooperative missions offer smaller encounters.

cards.heading: Recognisable sounds in battle
cards.text: Blasters, lightsabers and TIE fighter engines retain recognisable sounds from the films. DICE worked with the Lucasfilm archives and added recordings where interactive situations required further variations. Listening helps players identify weapons, vehicles and nearby threats.

main.title: Rainbow Six Siege
main.subtitle: Breaching and defending a changing room
main.summary: Rainbow Six Siege is Ubisoft?s 2015 tactical shooter, built around team roles, specialised gadgets and destructible environments.

cards.heading: Operators in short tactical rounds
cards.text: Rainbow Six Siege is Ubisoft?s 2015 tactical shooter, released on December 1 for Windows, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One. Short rounds pit asymmetric teams against one another. Operators bring specialised gadgets, while destructible walls, doors and floors let teams change routes and lines of fire.

cards.heading: Opening routes through walls
cards.text: Opening a wall can create an entrance or a new firing angle, but also removes protection. Teams use drones, cameras, sounds and small visual clues to locate opponents. A room?s possible approaches can change during the round.

cards.heading: Gadgets and team composition
cards.text: Operators contribute different tools for gathering information, opening surfaces, blocking access or protecting allies. Selecting a team means choosing abilities that work together. Players must coordinate their timing as well as their aim.

cards.heading: Testing before and after launch
cards.text: Ubisoft delayed the release to December to improve cooperation, weapon and gadget balance, menus, matchmaking and infrastructure after testing. Following launch, updates continued changing maps, operators and systems in response to play.

main.title: Mario & Luigi: Paper Jam
main.subtitle: A third traveller steps out of a book
main.summary: Mario & Luigi: Paper Jam is AlphaDream's Nintendo 3DS role-playing crossover between Mario & Luigi and Paper Mario. Luigi opens a book containing a paper world, releasing its inhabitants into the Mushroom Kingdom. Mario and Luigi join Paper Mario to rescue two versions of Princess Peach from two collaborating Bowsers. The premise gives the familiar travelling pair another playable companion with a distinctly different body. The humour of meeting a paper counterpart is also a design opportunity, because the new arrival can reach places and perform actions unavailable to the other two.

cards.heading: A third traveller steps out of a book
cards.text: Mario & Luigi: Paper Jam is AlphaDream's Nintendo 3DS role-playing crossover between Mario & Luigi and Paper Mario. Luigi opens a book containing a paper world, releasing its inhabitants into the Mushroom Kingdom. Mario and Luigi join Paper Mario to rescue two versions of Princess Peach from two collaborating Bowsers. The premise gives the familiar travelling pair another playable companion with a distinctly different body. The humour of meeting a paper counterpart is also a design opportunity, because the new arrival can reach places and perform actions unavailable to the other two.

cards.heading: Three buttons keep the team together
cards.text: Each member of the trio has a separate control button during exploration and timed battle actions. Paper Mario's thin body can squeeze through narrow gaps, while new shared moves gradually expand what the group can reach. Combat continues to combine turn-based choices with precise inputs for attacking and avoiding incoming blows. The additional traveller makes those sequences more involved without discarding the series' basic language. The player learns to recognise who needs to act, using the differences between the three characters to give an ordinary movement or attack another arrangement.

cards.heading: Paper becomes something enormous
cards.text: Selected encounters place the heroes on large papercraft figures that fight in an open arena, turning a fragile material into the basis of an oversized battle. Elsewhere, finding hidden Paper Toads gives the surrounding areas another task to support. Battle Cards add effects that can change the conditions of an encounter as the adventure progresses. Paper Jam uses the crossover most directly when the material difference becomes an action: a body fits through a gap, a group coordinates a move or a constructed figure changes the scale of the fight.
